verdict.rationale: The evidence shows how fixes reach devices. There is a dedicated Nitrokey 3 firmware-update guide, an official nitropy CLI that installs and runs, and open-source firmware with tagged releases (v1.8.3), so field updates are clearly supported. Nothing in the pack shows a security advisory program, a vulnerability disclosure or response process, or a way to look up which models are affected. Missing for 10: published security advisories, an affected-model/version lookup, a documented vulnerability-response process, and independent corroboration of the update flow.
